title: RandomEffectsUI
description: A simple plugin Random effects of Minecraft!
body:
Simple plugin for Minecraft!

Every 30 seconds imposes a random effect on all players online. In this plugin, the effect of instant damage has been removed, but all effects will still remain. You can also configure it in the plugins folder. 
plugins ---> RandomEffectsUI--->config.yml. 
Go to this path and run config.yml. You will find all the settings for this plugin.

Installation:

1. Install the .jar file

2. Transfer to the plugins folder

3. Restart the server

Compatibility: Spigot / Paper 1.21.11
